title: How to enlarge cursor on Mac: simple steps for better visibility in ChatGPT
metaTitle: How to enlarge cursor on Mac: System Settings Guide
description: Learn how to enlarge cursor on Mac to improve visibility while using ChatGPT. Follow our simple, step-by-step guide to adjust your system pointer settings today.
targetKeyword: how to enlarge cursor on mac
intro: To enlarge the cursor on your Mac, you must adjust the system-wide settings in macOS. There is no specific setting within the ChatGPT desktop app to change the cursor size independently of your Mac system configuration.
tldr: Open System Settings from the Apple menu.
Navigate to Accessibility and select Display.
Adjust the Pointer size slider to your preference.
Enable Shake mouse pointer to locate for quick visibility.

blocks.text: Why you cannot change the cursor inside ChatGPT

The ChatGPT desktop app for Mac is designed to follow your system appearance settings. It does not have an internal menu for mouse or pointer customization. When you change your cursor size in macOS, the change applies globally across all your applications, including the ChatGPT app, your browser, and your desktop environment.
How to enlarge cursor on Mac system settings
Adjusting the pointer size is a straightforward process in modern macOS versions. This change is immediate and does not require a restart of your computer or the ChatGPT app.

items: Click the Apple menu () in the top-left corner of your screen.
Select System Settings from the dropdown menu.
Use the sidebar to scroll down and click Accessibility.
Select Display from the list of options on the right.
Locate the Pointer section near the bottom of the window.
Drag the Pointer size slider to the right to increase your cursor size.

blocks.text: Using Shake to locate your cursor

If you struggle to find your cursor on a large display or across multiple monitors, the shake feature is highly effective. When enabled, a quick jiggle of your mouse or trackpad makes the cursor grow temporarily. This is often more useful than keeping a large cursor on screen all day.

items: Return to System Settings > Accessibility > Display.
Find the option labeled Shake mouse pointer to locate.
Toggle the switch to the ON position.
Test it by quickly moving your mouse back and forth.

blocks.text: Visibility is a core component of digital accessibility. Many users find that a slightly larger pointer reduces eye strain during long sessions in ChatGPT. While the app itself focuses on text-based interaction, your ability to interact with the interface depends on the comfort of your input device.

If you find that the pointer size slider is grayed out, check if you are using a managed device. Many corporate Macs have restricted access to System Settings. In these cases, you must reach out to your IT administrator to request an accessibility exception.

Some users report that the pointer size reset after a system update. This is rare but can happen if your settings sync with an iCloud profile that has different accessibility preferences. If this occurs, simply navigate back to the Display settings and re-adjust the slider.

faq.question: Does changing cursor size affect ChatGPT performance?
faq.answer: No, changing your cursor size is a system-level display setting and has no impact on the performance or processing speed of the ChatGPT app.

faq.question: Can I have a large cursor only in ChatGPT?
faq.answer: No, macOS does not support application-specific cursor sizes. The setting you choose in Accessibility will apply to the entire operating system.

faq.question: Where is the cursor setting on older macOS versions?
faq.answer: On versions prior to macOS Ventura, you can find these settings by going to the Apple menu > System Preferences > Accessibility > Display.

steps.name: Open System Settings
steps.text: Click the Apple menu in the top-left corner of your screen and select System Settings.

steps.name: Navigate to Accessibility
steps.text: In the sidebar of the System Settings window, scroll down until you see Accessibility and click it.

steps.name: Access Display Settings
steps.text: Click on the Display option in the right-hand panel.

steps.name: Adjust Pointer Size
steps.text: Scroll down to the Pointer section and drag the Pointer size slider to the right to make it larger.

troubleshooting.fix: Your Mac is likely managed by an administrator. Contact your IT department.
